_note: ADJUDICATION — board wins the STATES and the COPY, code wins the CHASSIS.
The three outcomes the board draws all exist and are wired
(CreatePageConfirmModal / CreatePageSuccessModal / CreatePageErrorModal, with
tests in __tests__/CreatePageModals.test.tsx), with the board's button roles
and order: Cancel | Create page, Open page settings | Done, Cancel | Try again.
That half of the board is conformed and stays conformed.
The CARD is a different matter and is deliberately not conformed. Board
1169:4726/4735/4744 draw a 340-wide box with 16/14 padding, a 10px gap, a 1px
border and 11px buttons on 12/7 padding at radius 6. Three things say that is
not this product's modal:
1. 183:60 draws the modal chassis and NAMES it `modal/440` — 440 wide,
radius 12 — and 642:3095, the apply overlay on the very next board in this
family, is another `modal/440`. chrome-ui's `Modal` is built to those.
2. The identical frame props (white, #e5e7eb border, 16/16/14/14, radius 12,
gap 10) appear on 1170:4793 'variant-picker' (320), 1170:4802
'detach-confirm' (340) and 1172:4825 — whose layer NAME is a paragraph of
audit prose. That is a spec-sheet card, drawn in an inline-confirm idiom.
3. `Modal`'s 16/14 head padding was measured against six other modal boards
its footer caps buttons at 28 for the same reason.
One component sheet does not re-settle a chrome-wide primitive — the same rule
boards.json already records for BK_TEXT_INPUT_THEME (authority=open:input-fill,
2026-08-17). So the three frames are MEASURED and left SKIPPED rather than
scored against a chassis the rest of the board set contradicts.
What IS joined is the one property the board and the chassis agree on: the
8px gap between a card's two actions. `Modal` gained a `testId` prop for this
— it was the only overlay in chrome-ui with no anchor at all, and recipes may
not name a CSS class.
